prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Company news: software, SaaS, database and cybersecurity.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Every material company-specific news item for US-listed software, SaaS, database and cybersecurity companies >= $1B in the window, as many as you can find: press releases, 8-K filings, executive changes, activist campaigns, legal settlements, contracts, product launches, guidance, analyst rating/PT changes (firm, old → new), and the stock move. One bullet per company.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **PTC** `[Software & SaaS]`
- Schneider Electric agreed to acquire **PTC** for **$205 per share in cash**, valuing PTC’s equity at approximately **$22.6 billion** and enterprise value at **$23.7 billion**; the offer represents a **42.3% premium** to PTC’s previous closing price, with completion expected in **Q3 2027**. PTC rose **37% in pre-market trading** on October 5. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 06:48 ET)[1][4]
- Schneider Electric’s agreement confirmed reports published on **October 4** regarding the proposed acquisition. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 06:48 ET)[1]

## Cybersecurity `[Software & SaaS]`
- **Palo Alto Networks (PANW)**, **CrowdStrike (CRWD)** and **Fortinet (FTNT)** were identified in an October 5 market commentary as listed cybersecurity companies benefiting from increased cyber-defense spending; the cited September 30 closing prices were **$397.31**, **$264.75** and **$178.76**, respectively. The source did not report a new company-specific announcement or October 5 price move for any of the three companies. (Adalytica, Oct. 5, 00:43 ET)[8]

## **IBM** `[Software & SaaS]`
- An October 2 cybersecurity M&A roundup reported that **IBM** and **Palo Alto Networks** had unveiled new acquisitions, but the available search result did not provide the acquisition targets, transaction values, publication time, or stock moves. (Infosecurity Magazine, Oct. 2, time unavailable)[10]

## **Thales** `[Cybersecurity]`
- Thales introduced **Luna 8**, a post-quantum-capable hardware security module; **CipherTrust Data Security Posture Management**, an AI-enabled data-security product; and **Sentinel Envelope+**, software protection against AI-powered attacks. It also announced a Google Cloud partnership involving its **AI Security Fabric** for securing AI agents, data and interactions. (DefenseHere, Oct. 2, 05:10 ET)[3]

## **SGS acquisition of Prescient Security** `[Cybersecurity]`
- SGS completed the acquisition of a **majority stake** in US cybersecurity and compliance company **Prescient Security**, which has more than **350 employees** and **5,000 customers worldwide**. (Prescient Security, Oct. 2, time unavailable)[7]

### Coverage limitation
- The available search results did not provide sufficient, verifiable details to compile a complete list of all qualifying US-listed software, SaaS, database and cybersecurity company events in the requested window, including many analyst actions, earnings updates, SEC filings and company-specific pre-market moves.
